in_sanskrit.name: गोलक
in_sanskrit.meaning: गोपालक (गोपाल के साथ होते हुए) या कोटियों का किटाब (हिन्दू धर्म में पूजा के लिए)

in_marathi.name: Golak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Golak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Golak originated from the Sanskrit language and is derived from the word 'Gopala', meaning 'cowherd' or 'milkman'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Krishna, who was a cowherd and was known to take care of the cows and calves. The name Golak carries the spiritual meaning of protection, care, and nurturing.
